column3: The two ends have a TLS cipher suite in common (SKIP_UNSUPPORTED otherwise)
Both ends declare the fixture F (SKIP_UNSUPPORTED otherwise)
The server becomes ready with the fixture (INFRA_ERROR otherwise)
The client registers its device and finds the fixture's PIN
The client reads the server's DeviceCapability
The client finds the fixture's DER programs with their controls, default controls and curves
The client reports the fixture's metering
The client subscribes to its DER program list, the server changes it (call issue-control) and notifies the client
After a successful subscribe, the server reported subscription-created
The client responds to the control that is active now, and the server accepts the response
The client posts the fixture's log event
The client puts the fixture's DER capability, settings, status and availability
The client posts the fixture's flow reservation request
The client finds the fixture's tariffs, rate components and intervals
A device of the same CA that the server did not provision is not registered
A server that let the unprovisioned device create its EndDevice reported device-registered
A device certificate of another CA is refused (exit 3)
The server's stdout is JSON Lines only
